text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—The "JBC Classic." What will be put to 
the test today is—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Have the three of us become equals 
standing side by side? Right, Trainer!?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, that's right! Go give it your all 
out there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey was once in the position of 
chasing after Hokko Tarumae and Wonder 
Acute.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet now, things are different. Growth is 
put to the test, and as for the other two—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I went and ran a whole ton this 
time! Enough to make up for the long time 
I was resting.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I can finally show Rickey. The real me!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My energy's fully topped up now~! I got a 
whole heap of motivation from the two of 
you, too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to show everyone today— a way of 
winning that only I can pull off~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Tarumae and Acute-san are both in top 
form. And so am I. Now, finally—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(The "Four Symbols in harmony." We might 
have reached it. That ideal balance of 
power.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Today's race is to put that to the test. 
To see if everyone became the best version 
of themselves.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: (And if everyone has reached that point—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do it! Tarumae, 
Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's make it the happiest race ever, with 
everyone giving it everything they've got☆
